shortDescription: Polymarket’s submarket for the LoL LCS playoff match between Shopify Rebellion and Sentinels saw the odds for Shopify Rebellion in the third-game winner market jump from 33.5% one hour earlier to 94.5%, a 61% swing. According to ChainCatcher, the sharp move may reflect the impact of breaking news.
